  stop("tables directory not found at: ", tables_dir,
       "\nCheck that Downloads/AC_combined_analysis/Adriana_analysis/tables exists.")

```{r libraries}
library(readxl)
```

```{r preview-function}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# preview_txt(): writes header info + sample rows for a
# tab-delimited text file into the shared output connection
# ---------------------------------------------------------
preview_txt <- function(filename, n_rows = 20, full = FALSE, con) {
  filepath <- file.path(tables_dir, filename)

  if (!file.exists(filepath)) {
    writeLines(paste("===== MISSING:", filename, "====="), con)
    writeLines("", con)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  header <- readLines(filepath, n = 1)
  ncols  <- length(strsplit(header, "\t")[[1]])
  total_lines <- length(readLines(filepath))

  writeLines(paste("=====", filename, "====="), con)
  writeLines(paste("columns:", ncols), con)
  writeLines(paste("rows:", total_lines), con)
  writeLines("--- header ---", con)
  writeLines(header, con)
  writeLines("--- sample rows ---", con)

  if (full) {
    body <- readLines(filepath)[-1]
  } else {
    body <- readLines(filepath, n = n_rows + 1)[-1]
  }
  writeLines(body, con)
  writeLines("", con)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# preview_xlsx(): writes sheet names + header + sample rows
# for each sheet in an Excel file
# ---------------------------------------------------------
preview_xlsx <- function(filename, n_rows = 20, con) {
  filepath <- file.path(tables_dir, filename)

  if (!file.exists(filepath)) {
    writeLines(paste("===== MISSING:", filename, "====="), con)
    writeLines("", con)
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  sheets <- excel_sheets(filepath)
  writeLines(paste("===== ", filename, " — sheets:", paste(sheets, collapse = ", "), "====="), con)
  writeLines("", con)

  for (s in sheets) {
    df <- read_excel(filepath, sheet = s, n_max = n_rows)
    writeLines(paste("--- sheet:", s, "---"), con)
    writeLines(paste("columns:", ncol(df)), con)
    writeLines(paste(colnames(df), collapse = "\t"), con)
    writeLines("--- sample rows ---", con)
    write.table(df, con, sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    writeLines("", con)
  }
}
```

```{r run-previews}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Output file: written into project_dir (not tables/)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
out_path <- file.path(project_dir, "table_previews.txt")
con <- file(out_path, "w")

# Large tables — sample only
preview_txt("PCA_genes_AC.txt", n_rows = 20, con = con)
preview_txt("Combined_norm_table_AC.txt", n_rows = 20, con = con)
preview_txt("norm_table.txt", n_rows = 20, con = con)
preview_txt("MS251208_express-1.5.1.Candida+cerevisiae.2x50mers.TPM_with_both_names.table.txt",
            n_rows = 30, con = con)

# Small tables — dump in full
preview_txt("combined_sample_info.txt", full = TRUE, con = con)
preview_txt("MS251208_sample_info.txt", full = TRUE, con = con)
preview_txt("PCA_samples_AC.txt", full = TRUE, con = con)

close(con)
cat("Done. Preview written to:", out_path, "\n")
```

```{r run-xlsx-preview}
out_path_xlsx <- file.path(project_dir, "supp_table3_preview.txt")
con_xlsx <- file(out_path_xlsx, "w")

preview_xlsx("Supp Table 3.xlsx", n_rows = 20, con = con_xlsx)

close(con_xlsx)
cat("Done. Preview written to:", out_path_xlsx, "\n")
```
